title: Prioritisation: risk versus the cost of mitigation

videos.script: Every control on the clinic's list is a good idea. That is the problem. Eleven good ideas, one small budget, and a team that can build a few things a month. {{eleven}} So the question changes. Not is this control worth having, but which ones first. {{which}} The answer starts with arithmetic. What a control costs per year, against the expected loss it takes away. A database account with less power costs almost nothing and removes a lot. A new PDF viewer costs more than the risk it covers. {{ratio}} Then the arithmetic gets one correction. Two controls on the same risk do not both get the full credit. {{overlap}} And at the end, the plan is checked against the owner's appetite. Four controls, under six thousand reais a year, are enough to meet it. {{plan}}
